generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, reflection is something you practise across the School of Sport and beyond. Each report a scientist reviews, each session a coach or strength and conditioning coach looks back on, each rehabilitation a therapist reconsiders, each honest account of what you would change, is the habit at work. It is also what professional sport expects. Across coaching, science, management, therapy and strength and conditioning, the ability to learn from experience, deliberately and honestly, is part of competent, ethical practice.
